title: FATHER, GIVE US THIS DAY OUR DAILY BREAD
text: Father, I come before your throne of grace in the mighty [music] name of Jesus Christ, acknowledging [singing] that you are Jehovah Gyra, the Lord, my provider, the God who sees and provides, the one who supplies all my needs according to his riches in glory by Christ Jesus.
